Checks.Name: Architecture node total
Checks.Details: Architecture statistics must equal the actual node array.

Checks.Name: Architecture edge total
Checks.Details: Architecture statistics must equal the actual edge array.

Checks.Name: Unique architecture files
Checks.Details: Every architecture node must map to one unique source file.

Checks.Name: Unique architecture node IDs
Checks.Details: Every architecture node ID must be unique.

Checks.Name: Internal edge references
Checks.Details: Every internal import edge must reference two architecture nodes.

Checks.Name: Unresolved internal imports
Checks.Details: Internal imports should resolve to known source files.

Checks.Name: Architecture source files exist
Checks.Details: Every architecture node must exist in the current project tree.

Checks.Name: Architecture entry-point total
Checks.Details: Entry-point statistics must match entry-point nodes.

Checks.Name: Workflow architecture model version
Checks.Details: Workflow analysis must reference the current architecture model version.

Checks.Name: Workflow record total
Checks.Details: Workflow statistics must equal the workflow record array.

Checks.Name: Unique workflow records
Checks.Details: Every workflow file must have one workflow record.

Checks.Name: Workflow files in architecture model
Checks.Details: Every workflow record must reference an architecture node.

Checks.Name: Unique entry traces
Checks.Details: Every entry file must have one trace.

Checks.Name: Entry-trace total
Checks.Details: Every architecture entry point must have one integration trace.

Checks.Name: Entry traces in architecture model
Checks.Details: Every entry trace must reference an architecture node.

Checks.Name: Runtime API call total
Checks.Details: Workflow statistics must equal the runtime API call array.

Checks.Name: Unresolved runtime API calls
Checks.Details: Every detected runtime API call should resolve to an API route.

Checks.Name: Runtime API graph references
Checks.Details: Resolved runtime calls must reference known source and target nodes.

Checks.Name: Engine registry exists
Checks.Details: The architecture audit requires the generated engine registry.

Checks.Name: Engine registry record total
Checks.Details: The engine-record table must match its architecture-system summary count.

Checks.Name: Engine registry required fields
Checks.Details: Purpose, inputs, outputs, dependencies, consumers, workflow/AI positions, risk, duplicate detection, and integration points are required.
